problems.reason: The age range for the holotype skull (72.98–72.62 Ma) conflicts with the broader temporal range given for the genus (83.6–72.2 Ma).
Both sentences state that Ziapelta is an extinct ankylosaurid dinosaur, repeating the same classification claim.
The sentence discusses the recolonization of North America by ankylosaurids in general, not specifically about Ziapelta itself.

notes: - contradiction: "The holotype skull of Ziapelta dates to between 72.98 and 72.62 million years ago." / "The genus Ziapelta lived from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.": The age range for the holotype skull (72.98–72.62 Ma) conflicts with the broader temporal range given for the genus (83.6–72.2 Ma).
